name: tab-session-large-region
description: The state read of a region whose session is over 1 MiB decoded is dropped from the stored session of its tab, and the other region of the tab is written; a tab whose every region is over the limit writes the removal of its file.
reason: The tab sessions read and write the tab-sessions files of the configuration directory and the document regions read the state of a window; the producer builds neither state (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
